[EN] We're having trouble pushing forward, but we can't move backward at this point. They're gathering forces, and if we turn, they'll just destroy us from behind.

Whimnia is convinced that {@LinkCreature:6#3031#Lokian reavers} and {@LinkCreature:6#3032#mystics} are in the base.

I need you to go find out if that's true—and if it is, I need you to make it not be true anymore—if you're picking up what I'm putting down.
[ES] Tenemos problemas para avanzar, pero no podemos retroceder en este punto. Están reuniendo fuerzas y, si giramos, simplemente nos destrozarán por la espalda.

Whimnia está convencida de que hay {@LinkCreature:6#3031#Lokian reavers} y {@LinkCreature:6#3032#mystics} en la base.

Necesito que vayas a averiguar si eso es verdad, y si lo es, necesito que dejes de ser verdad si me entiendes.

[EN] Great, thanks. You've given us a chance to regroup.
[ES] Genial, gracias. Nos diste la oportunidad de reagruparnos.
